faq.refferal2: Will I get any reward for inviting friends?
faq.refferal_ans2:
Of course! We generously reward those who invite new friends to our project.

You will receive 10% in three levels (5%-3%-2%) from every purchase your referral makes.
faq.refferal_ans1: Yes, on the Friends page you can invite your friends and see full statistics about your referrals.
faq.balance3: How long does it take to deposit or withdraw?
faq.balance_ans3: Deposits and withdrawals of TON are instant. It usually takes no more than 30 seconds.
faq.balance_ans2:
On the Balance page, there is a form to withdraw TON. You need to enter your wallet address and click the MAX button.

The minimum withdrawal amount is 0.1 TON.
faq.balance1: How to top up the balance?
faq.balance_ans1: You simply need to go to the Balance page, connect your TON wallet, or use a direct transfer via MEMO.
faq.what_civilization_ans3: To get started, top up your Balance and buy your first Planet.
faq.what_civilization_ans2:
Yes, you really earn rewards in TON for playing.

But keep in mind that CivilizationTon is a game where all top-ups are voluntary donations.
faq.what_civilization_ans: Civilization is a unique P2E game where you can earn rewards in TON.
